beats.text: Now, which tool for which step? Here is what the measurements say.
If the step is **numbers**, use a rule. On the box call, no model beat it by a margin I could measure, and it cost nothing.
If the step is reading **text** into a typed answer, a small typed model is fast, and good at yes-or-no questions. It was weaker at **counting**.
If the step must **write**, use the language model, and keep the facts in code.
And measure on your own labeled data. A model that never says yes can still look **well** calibrated.
